gabriel.name: Gabriel
gabriel.title: Gabriel (Jibril)
gabriel.dict: The angel who brings the revelation down to the Prophet's heart (2:97). Named three times (2:97-98, 66:4). Tradition identifies him with the "Holy Spirit" and the "Trustworthy Spirit" that bring the Quran (16:102, 26:193) and with the spirit sent to Mary (19:17).

gog-and-magog.name: Gog and Magog
gog-and-magog.title: Gog and Magog
gog-and-magog.dict: A people spreading chaos in the land, shut behind Dhul-Qarnayn's barrier of iron (18:94-98) until they are let loose before the end (21:96).

goliath.name: Goliath
goliath.title: Goliath (Jalut)
goliath.dict: The enemy whom Saul's small force faces; "David killed Goliath" (2:249-251).
